______________________________/
On order of the Chief Justice, the motions of Yvon D. Roustan and Estela M.
Roustan for leave to file an amicus curiae brief and for leave to file a supplemental
amicus curiae brief are GRANTED. The Roustans shall file the requisite number of
copies of a single amicus brief no later than fourteen days after respondent-appellee files
his brief on appeal. MCR 7.306(D)(1); MCR 7.309.
I, Larry S. Royster, Clerk of the Michigan Supreme Court, certify that the
foregoing is a true and complete copy of the order entered at the direction of the Court.
January 2, 2014
Clerk
